requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Solution
requirements.Description: Develop HP's first business ink tank printer targeting SMBs, offering cost-effective, high-performance printing with low total cost of ownership (TCO).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a gap in HP's portfolio for the CISS PLE Hi segment and meets evolving SMB needs for ROI and efficiency.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Supports CISS technology, business tank design, and sustainability requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is launched with ink tank technology, achieves lowest business TCO among HP products, and is marketed to SMBs.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate AI-driven productivity features, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan, and advanced manageability tools for SMBs via a consolidated portal.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances workflow efficiency and device management for SMBs lacking dedicated IT teams.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI solution integration and portal development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features (Perfect Print/Scan) and SMB management portal are available and functional at launch.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage printers, targeting unmanaged or lightly managed businesses.
requirements.Rationale: Simplifies device management for SMBs without dedicated IT resources.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Portal must integrate with AI productivity features and PaaS.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is live, supports device management for SMBs, and integrates with Magellan printers.

requirements.Title: Low Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design printer with maintenance-free or reduced maintenance features, including fewer parts to replace over product life and a replaceable maintenance box.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB pain points related to printer upkeep and reduces intervention needs.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Supplies Quality, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer requires fewer maintenance interventions compared to competitors; maintenance box is replaceable by customers or service centers.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% RCP
requirements.Description: Ensure printer design uses at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), surpassing competitors (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Meets growing customer demand for sustainable products and provides a competitive advantage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer contains minimum 60% RCP in its plastic parts, validated by supply chain and regulatory audits.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Provide warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever comes first) and enable customer replaceable parts (PHA) and service center replaceable parts (MINK), with a target for customer replaceability post-warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and intervention costs for SMB customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Supplies Quality, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Design for replaceability, service center training.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published; PHA parts are user-replaceable; MINK parts are service center replaceable; customer replaceability achieved for targeted components.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refilling
requirements.Description: Implement keyed bottles for ink refilling to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure user-friendly operation.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and reduces risk of errors during ink replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are compatible with Magellan printers and prevent incorrect filling; validated by user testing.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU – SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a non-PDL SKU that supports SMB2.0 Solutions and an advanced view SMB portal, and is compatible with PaaS.
requirements.Rationale: Provides differentiated solutions for SMBs and supports HP's PaaS strategy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU supports SMB2.0 Solutions, advanced portal, and PaaS integration.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU – Speed and Compatibility
requirements.Description: Develop a PDL SKU with improved speed (25/20 ppm) and support for PDL/PS and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses performance needs and regulatory requirements for managed SMBs and enterprise customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves specified speed, supports PDL/PS, and obtains Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Integrate telemetry features for remote monitoring, usage analytics, and proactive support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables HP and customers to monitor device health, usage, and optimize support.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal integration, telemetry data privacy compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry features are available, data is securely transmitted and accessible via SMB portal.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing functionality through the HP App for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Meets modern SMB needs for flexible, mobile workflow solutions.
requirements.Dependencies: HP App integration, printer firmware compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printers support mobile printing via HP App; validated by end-user testing.

requirements.Title: PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan printers are compatible with HP's Printing-as-a-Service (PaaS) platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP's strategic goal to accelerate PaaS adoption and coverage.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal and solution integration, firmware updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printers are registered and functional within HP's PaaS platform.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Include a replaceable maintenance box as a new feature for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces maintenance downtime and intervention for SMB customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Supplies Quality, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is user-replaceable and validated by customer testing.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel certification for environmental compliance on PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets regulatory and sustainability requirements for SMB and enterprise markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU is certified by Blue Angel authority.

requirements.Title: Advanced Scan Workflow
requirements.Description: Provide advanced scan workflow capabilities powered by AI, enhancing document processing efficiency for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Improves productivity and document management for SMB customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Advanced scan workflow is operational and validated by user testing.

requirements.Title: Competitive TCO Benchmarking
requirements.Description: Benchmark Magellan printer's TCO against competitors to ensure HP's lowest business TCO claim is substantiated.
requirements.Rationale: Supports marketing claims and ensures product delivers on cost efficiency promises.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printer's TCO is validated to be lower than competitors (Epson, Canon, etc.) via published benchmarks.
